-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.InvNodeRule` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem nodeCrash [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] [CrashGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (x
    : CrashNames) (E : CoPset) (HE : ↑N ⊆ E) : ⊢ isCluster γ N -∗ crashed -∗ nodeCrashTok γ id x
    ={E}=∗ nodeVacant γ id

def skippedIn [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (l : List LogEntry) (a b : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  [∗list] j ∈ List.range' a (b - a), iprop(∀ e, ⌜l[j]? = some e ∧ e.isConfChange⌝ → confDecided γ j ConfDecision.skip)

def (sealed) nodeInstalledIndex (γ : Cluster) (n : NodeH) (i : w64) : IProp GF

def isStorage (γ : Cluster) (K : GName) (st : Storage) (SV : SnapshotM → IProp GF := snapshotValid
    γ) : IProp GF :=
  isStorageP γ.maxData.isSome SV (storBnd γ K) (nodeCommitLb γ K) st

theorem nodeRunning_stopped [package_sem : Assumptions] (n : NodeH) (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (q
    : Qp) : nodeRunning n γ N q ∗ nodeStopped n γ N ⊢ False

theorem restartAu_nc (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (σ : StorContents) (Q : RaftState →
    IProp GF) : AU <{ ∃∃ S, ▷ raftState γ id S ∗ ⌜StorageHolds S σ⌝ }> @ ⊤ \ ↑N, ∅ <{ raftState γ id
    S, COMM Q S }> ⊢ notCrashed -∗ AU <{ ∃∃ S, ▷ raftState γ id S ∗ ⌜StorageHolds S σ⌝ }> @ ⊤ \ ↑N,
    ∅ <{ raftState γ id S, COMM notCrashed ∗ Q S }>

theorem Membership.Valid.snapListsOk {m : Membership} {cs : ConfStateM} {t i : w64} {d : List w8} :
    m.Valid → confStateIs cs m → ¬W64 0 ∈ m.ids → (∀ (k : w64), k ∈ m.learnersNext → ¬k ∈ m.voters)
    → GMap.size m.ids < 2 ^ 61 → uint.Z i < 2 ^ 61 → SnapListsOk { sid := { term' := t, index' := i
    }, cl := cs.lists, al := m.autoLeave, dat := d }

theorem skippedIn_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (l : List LogEntry) (a b : Nat) :
    Persistent (skippedIn γ l a b)

theorem cluster_alloc_ns [package_sem : Assumptions] (N : Namespace) (vs : List w64) (ctxs : List
    (List w8)) (boot : List LogEntry) (dup : Bool) (sl : w64 → Option GName) (md : Option Nat) (E :
    CoPset) (ns : Bool) (Hns : ns = true → boot ≠ []) : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 2 → vs ≠ [] →
    vs.Nodup → ¬W64 0 ∈ vs → ↑vs.length < 2 ^ 62 → (boot ≠ [] → BootLog vs ctxs boot) → (∀ (b :
    Nat), md = some b → b ≤ 2 ^ 31) → (∀ (b : Nat), md = some b → ∀ (e : LogEntry), e ∈ boot →
    e.data.length ≤ b) → ⊢ (if boot = [] then emp else bootMarshal vs ctxs (LogEntry.toEntries boot
    0)) ={E}=∗ ∃ γ, ⌜γ.dup = dup ∧ γ.snapLoc = sl ∧ γ.bootLen = boot.length ∧ γ.maxData = md ∧
    (clusterNoSnap γ ↔ ns = true)⌝ ∗ ⌜γ.trace = none⌝ ∗ ownCommittedOps γ boot ∗ ownReadCtxs γ ∅ ∗
    isCluster γ N ∗ ownConfDecisions γ ∅ ∗ confAt γ 0 (Membership.simple (listToSet vs)) ∗
    ownSnapsMade γ [] ∗ ([∗list] id ∈ vs, iprop(raftState γ id RaftState.init ∗ nodeVacant γ id)) ∗
    if boot = [] then joinAuth γ (listToSet vs) else isCommittedLogLb γ boot ∗ [∗list] id ∈ vs,
    nodeBoot γ N vs ctxs id

def (sealed) confDecided [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (k : Nat) (d : ConfDecision) : IProp GF

theorem isStorage_tagTrue [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (K : GName) (st : Storage) :
    isStorage γ K st ⊢ isStorageT γ K (fun x => iprop(True)) st

def (sealed) storBnd (γ : Cluster) (K : GName) (c : Nat) : IProp GF

theorem committed_confDecodes [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (l : List
    LogEntry) : isCluster γ N ∗ isCommittedLogLb γ l ⊢ ⌜∀ (e : LogEntry), e ∈ l → e.isConfChange →
    ConfEntryDecodes e⌝

theorem confDecided_agree [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (k : Nat) (d1 d2 : ConfDecision) :
    confDecided γ k d1 ∗ confDecided γ k d2 ⊢ ⌜d1 = d2⌝

theorem confAt_timeless [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (k : Nat) (m : Membership) : Timeless (confAt γ
    k m)

theorem ownConfDecisions_lookup [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (D : GMap Nat ConfDecision)
    (k : Nat) (d : ConfDecision) : ownConfDecisions γ D ∗ confDecided γ k d ⊢ ⌜D !! k = some d⌝

theorem nodeStartedFresh_persistent (n : NodeH) (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (vs : List w64) (ctxs
    : List (List w8)) (id : w64) : Persistent (nodeStartedFresh n γ N vs ctxs id)

theorem snapshotCert_made [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (k : SnapTrip) :
    isCluster γ N ∗ snapshotCert γ N k ⊢ ∃ l m, isCommittedLogLb γ l ∗ confAt γ l.length m ∗
    snapMade γ { index := l.length, conf := m, data := k.dat } ∗ ⌜l.length = uint.nat k.sid.index' ∧
    Option.map LogEntry.term l.getLast? = some k.sid.term' ∧ k.cl.Is m ∧ k.al = m.autoLeave⌝

def (sealed) joinAuth [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (U : GSet w64) : IProp GF

theorem snapTo_confAt [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (E : CoPset) (HE :
    ↑N ⊆ E) (id : w64) (st : MsgSt) (k0 : Nat) (m0 : Membership) (Hty : st.msg.Type' = MsgSnap) : ⊢
    isCluster γ N -∗ confAt γ k0 m0 -∗ snapTo γ id st ={E}=∗ ⌜st.msg.To' ≠ id⌝ ∗ ∃ k m l, confAt γ k
    m ∗ isCommittedLogLb γ l ∗ ⌜k ≤ l.length ∧ st.msg.To' ∈ m.ids⌝

theorem cluster_alloc [package_sem : Assumptions] (N : Namespace) (vs : List w64) (ctxs : List (List
    w8)) (boot : List LogEntry) (dup : Bool) (sl : w64 → Option GName) (md : Option Nat) (E :
    CoPset) : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 2 → vs ≠ [] → vs.Nodup → ¬W64 0 ∈ vs → ↑vs.length < 2 ^ 62
    → (boot ≠ [] → BootLog vs ctxs boot) → (∀ (b : Nat), md = some b → b ≤ 2 ^ 31) → (∀ (b : Nat),
    md = some b → ∀ (e : LogEntry), e ∈ boot → e.data.length ≤ b) → ⊢ (if boot = [] then emp else
    bootMarshal vs ctxs (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0)) ={E}=∗ ∃ γ, ⌜γ.dup = dup ∧ γ.snapLoc = sl ∧
    γ.bootLen = boot.length ∧ γ.maxData = md⌝ ∗ ⌜¬clusterNoSnap γ⌝ ∗ ⌜γ.trace = none⌝ ∗
    ownCommittedOps γ boot ∗ ownReadCtxs γ ∅ ∗ isCluster γ N ∗ ownConfDecisions γ ∅ ∗ confAt γ 0
    (Membership.simple (listToSet vs)) ∗ ownSnapsMade γ [] ∗ ([∗list] id ∈ vs, iprop(raftState γ id
    RaftState.init ∗ nodeVacant γ id)) ∗ if boot = [] then joinAuth γ (listToSet vs) else
    isCommittedLogLb γ boot ∗ [∗list] id ∈ vs, nodeBoot γ N vs ctxs id

theorem snapMade_elem [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (S : List SnapRec) (s : SnapRec) :
    ownSnapsMade γ S ∗ snapMade γ s ⊢ ⌜s ∈ S⌝

theorem snapMade_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (s : SnapRec) : Persistent (snapMade γ s)

theorem cluster_alloc_traced [package_sem : Assumptions] (N : Namespace) (vs : List w64) (ctxs :
    List (List w8)) (boot : List LogEntry) (dup : Bool) (sl : w64 → Option GName) (γd : GName) (md :
    Option Nat) (E : CoPset) : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 2 → vs ≠ [] → vs.Nodup → ¬W64 0 ∈ vs →
    ↑vs.length < 2 ^ 62 → BootLog vs ctxs boot → (∀ (b : Nat), md = some b → b ≤ 2 ^ 31) → (∀ (b :
    Nat), md = some b → ∀ (e : LogEntry), e ∈ boot → e.data.length ≤ b) → ⊢ bootMarshal vs ctxs
    (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0) ={E}=∗ ∃ γ, ⌜γ.dup = dup ∧ γ.snapLoc = sl ∧ γ.bootLen = boot.length
    ∧ γ.maxData = md⌝ ∗ ⌜γ.trace = some γd⌝ ∗ ownCommittedOps γ boot ∗ ownReadCtxs γ ∅ ∗ isCluster γ
    N ∗ ownConfDecisions γ ∅ ∗ confAt γ 0 (Membership.simple (listToSet vs)) ∗ ownSnapsMade γ [] ∗
    ([∗list] id ∈ vs, iprop(raftState γ id RaftState.init ∗ nodeVacant γ id)) ∗ isCommittedLogLb γ
    boot ∗ [∗list] id ∈ vs, nodeBoot γ N vs ctxs id

def snapshotValid [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (sv : SnapshotM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ l m,
      isCommittedLogLb γ l ∗
        confAt γ l.length m ∗
          snapMade γ { index := l.length, conf := m, data := sv.Data' } ∗
            ⌜l.length = uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index' ∧
                0 < l.length ∧
                  Option.map LogEntry.term l.getLast? = some sv.Metadata'.Term' ∧
                    confStateIs sv.Metadata'.ConfState' m ∧
                      l.length < 2 ^ 61 ∧
                        ↑sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.Voters'.length + ↑sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.Learners'.length +
                              ↑sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.VotersOutgoing'.length +
                            ↑sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.LearnersNext'.length ≤
                          2 ^ 62⌝)

theorem readySnapSources_installed_le [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (n : NodeH) (id
    handoutTerm : w64) (ms observed : List QMsg) (bound observedBound : Nat) (sourceInstall
    observedInstall : Option w64) (q : QMsg) (sv : SnapshotM) (hq : q ∈ ms) (ht : q.st.msg.Type' =
    MsgSnap) (hsv : q.st.snap = some sv) : ⊢ readySnapSources γ n id handoutTerm ms bound
    sourceInstall -∗ readySnapSources γ n id q.st.msg.Term' observed observedBound observedInstall
    -∗ snapshotLeader γ id q.st.msg.Term' -∗ nodeInstalledIndex γ n sv.Metadata'.Index' -∗ ⌜uint.nat
    sv.Metadata'.Index' ≤ observedBound⌝

theorem readySnapSources_installed [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (n : NodeH) (id term i
    : w64) (ms : List QMsg) (bound : Nat) : readySnapSources γ n id term ms bound (some i) ⊢
    nodeInstalledIndex γ n i

    Membership) : NoConfChangeIn l a b → a ≤ b → b ≤ l.length → isCommittedLogLb γ l ∗ confAt γ a m
    ⊢ confAt γ b m

    ConfDecision) : confAt γ k m ∗ confDecided γ k d ⊢ ∃ m', ⌜d.step m = some m'⌝ ∗ confAt γ (k + 1)
    m'

    γ.trace = none) (hns : clusterNoSnap γ → k ≤ 1) : ⊢ nodeAppliedLb γ K k -∗ ⌜c ≤ k⌝ -∗ storBnd γ
    K c

theorem committed_emptyV2_joint [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (l : List
    LogEntry) (k : Nat) (e : LogEntry) (m : Membership) : l[k]? = some e → e.isEmptyV2 → isCluster γ
    N ∗ isCommittedLogLb γ l ∗ confAt γ k m ⊢ ⌜m.isJoint⌝

    ConfDecision) : ownConfDecisions γ D1 ∗ ownConfDecisions γ D2 ⊢ False

def isStorageT (γ : Cluster) (K : GName) (Tg : SnapshotM → IProp GF) (st : Storage) : IProp GF :=
  isStorageP γ.maxData.isSome (fun sv => iprop(snapshotValid γ sv ∗ Tg sv)) (storBnd γ K) (nodeCommitLb γ K) st

theorem joinAuth_join [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (U : GSet w64) (id :
    w64) : ¬id ∈ U → id ≠ W64 0 → ⊢ isCluster γ N ∗ joinAuth γ U ==∗ joinAuth γ ({id} ∪ U) ∗
    raftState γ id RaftState.init ∗ nodeVacant γ id

theorem snapshotValid_timeless [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (sv : SnapshotM) : Timeless
    (snapshotValid γ sv)

theorem storBnd_cap [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (K : GName) (c : Nat) : storBnd γ K c ⊢
    ⌜clusterNoSnap γ → c ≤ 1⌝

theorem nodeVacant_armD [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] [CrashGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (id : w64) (E : CoPset)
    : ⊢ nodeVacant γ id ={E}=∗ ∃ x, nodeVacantA γ id x

theorem snapshotCert_valid [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (sv : SnapshotM)
    : 0 < uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index' → uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index' < 2 ^ 61 → isCluster γ N ∗
    snapshotCert γ N (snapTrip sv sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists) ⊢ snapshotValid γ sv

def (sealed) nodeStartedFresh (n : NodeH) (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (vs : List w64) (ctxs : List
    (List w8)) (id : w64) : IProp GF

def restartStorage (γ : Cluster) (st : Storage) (σ : StorContents) (csm : ConfStateM) (A : Nat) (F :
    GName → IProp GF) (SV : SnapshotM → IProp GF := snapshotValid γ) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ i R f,
      ⌜st = GoInterface.ok i⌝ ∗
        ⌜σ.b ≤ f ∧ f ≤ σ.commit⌝ ∗
          R ∗
            (□
                ∀ Φ,
                  R -∗
                    ▷ (R -∗ Φ (intoVal (W64 (↑σ.b + 1)), intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                      WP
                        ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"FirstIndex" i.v))
                          (intoVal ()))
                        {{ Φ }}) ∗
              (□
                  ∀ Φ,
                    R -∗
                      ▷ (R -∗ Φ (intoVal (W64 ↑σ.last), intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                        WP
                          ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"LastIndex" i.v))
                            (intoVal ()))
                          {{ Φ }}) ∗
                □
                  ∀ Φ,
                    R -∗
                      (▷
                          ∀ hp cs al,
                            (hsOpt hp σ.hs ∗
                                csPts cs DFrac.discard csm al ∗
                                  ∀ K,
                                    nodeAppliedLb γ K (max σ.b A) -∗
                                      nodeCommitLb γ K σ.commit ={⊤}=∗ isStorage γ K st SV ∗ storHolds st σ f ∗ F K) -∗
                              Φ ((intoVal hp, intoVal cs), intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                        WP
                          ((intoVal
                              (methods i.ty
                                go!"InitialState" i.v))
                            (intoVal ()))
                          {{ Φ }})

theorem confAt_skipped [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (l : List LogEntry) (a b : Nat) (m :
    Membership) : a ≤ b → b ≤ l.length → isCommittedLogLb γ l ∗ confAt γ a m ∗ skippedIn γ l a b ⊢
    confAt γ b m

theorem confAt_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (k : Nat) (m : Membership) : Persistent
    (confAt γ k m)

def (sealed) snapMade [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (s : SnapRec) : IProp GF

theorem confDecide [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (D : GMap Nat
    ConfDecision) (l : List LogEntry) (k : Nat) (e : LogEntry) (m m' : Membership) (d :
    ConfDecision) : D !! k = none → l[k]? = some e → e.isConfChange → d.step m = some m' → ⊢
    isCluster γ N ∗ isCommittedLogLb γ l ∗ confAt γ k m ∗ ownConfDecisions γ D ==∗ ownConfDecisions
    γ <[k := d]>D ∗ confDecided γ k d ∗ confAt γ (k + 1) m'

theorem ownConfDecisions_timeless [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (D : GMap Nat ConfDecision) :
    Timeless (ownConfDecisions γ D)

theorem nodeRestoreCert_persistent (γ : Cluster) (n : NodeH) (sv : SnapshotM) : Persistent
    (nodeRestoreCert γ n sv)

theorem ownSnapsMade_snapshotValid_data [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (S : List SnapRec)
    (sv : SnapshotM) : ownSnapsMade γ S ∗ snapshotValid γ sv ⊢ ⌜∃ r, r ∈ S ∧ r.data = sv.Data'⌝

theorem ownSnapsMade_timeless [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (S : List SnapRec) : Timeless
    (ownSnapsMade γ S)

theorem readySnapSources_sameTerm_le [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (n : NodeH) (id term
    : w64) (ms observed : List QMsg) (bound observedBound : Nat) (q : QMsg) (SV : SnapshotM → IProp
    GF) (hq : q ∈ ms) (ht : q.st.msg.Type' = MsgSnap) : ⊢ readySnapSources γ n id term ms bound -∗
    readySnapSources γ n id term observed observedBound -∗ snapshotLeader γ id term -∗ nodeTagPin γ
    n SV -∗ ∃ sv, ⌜q.st.snap = some sv⌝ ∗ (▷ SV sv ∨ ⌜uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index' ≤ observedBound⌝)

theorem ownConfDecisions_witness [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (D : GMap Nat ConfDecision)
    (k : Nat) (d : ConfDecision) : D !! k = some d → ownConfDecisions γ D ⊢ ownConfDecisions γ D ∗
    confDecided γ k d

theorem confDecided_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (k : Nat) (d : ConfDecision) :
    Persistent (confDecided γ k d)

theorem readySnapSources_msgSnap [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (n : NodeH) (id : w64)
    {term : w64} {bound : Nat} {installed : Option w64} (ms : List QMsg) (q : QMsg) (SV : SnapshotM
    → IProp GF) (hq : q ∈ ms) (ht : q.st.msg.Type' = MsgSnap) : ⊢ readySnapSources γ n id term ms
    bound installed -∗ nodeTagPin γ n SV -∗ ∃ sv, ⌜q.st.snap = some sv⌝ ∗ (▷ SV sv ∨ nodeRestoreCert
    γ n sv ∗ nodeRestoreSource γ id (snapId sv))

theorem isCluster_persistent [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) : Persistent
    (isCluster γ N)

theorem cluster_alloc_nb [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (N : Namespace) (vs : List w64) (dup : Bool) (sl
    : w64 → Option GName) (md : Option Nat) (E : CoPset) : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 2 → vs ≠ [] →
    vs.Nodup → ¬W64 0 ∈ vs → ↑vs.length < 2 ^ 62 → (∀ (b : Nat), md = some b → b ≤ 2 ^ 31) → ⊢
    |={E}=> ∃ γ, ⌜γ.dup = dup ∧ γ.snapLoc = sl ∧ γ.bootLen = 0 ∧ γ.maxData = md⌝ ∗ ⌜¬clusterNoSnap
    γ⌝ ∗ ⌜γ.trace = none⌝ ∗ ownCommittedOps γ [] ∗ ownReadCtxs γ ∅ ∗ isCluster γ N ∗
    ownConfDecisions γ ∅ ∗ confAt γ 0 (Membership.simple (listToSet vs)) ∗ ownSnapsMade γ [] ∗
    ([∗list] id ∈ vs, iprop(raftState γ id RaftState.init ∗ nodeVacant γ id)) ∗ joinAuth γ
    (listToSet vs)

theorem confAt_valid [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (k : Nat) (m : Membership) : confAt γ k
    m ⊢ ⌜m.Valid⌝

def storHolds (st : Storage) (σ : StorContents) (f : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ e0,
      ⌜e0.Term' = σ.base.term'⌝ ∗
        storCompacted st σ.b ∗
          storLog st σ.b DFrac.discard [e0] ∗
            storLog st (σ.b + 1) DFrac.discard (List.take (f - σ.b) σ.ents) ∗
              storLog st (f + 1) (DFrac.own 1) (List.drop (f - σ.b) σ.ents) ∗ storEnd st (σ.last + 1))

theorem nodeVacant_arm [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] [CrashGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (id : w64) (E : CoPset)
    : ⊢ nodeVacant γ id ={E}=∗ ∃ x, nodeVacantA γ id x ∗ nodeCrashTok γ id x

theorem isStorageT_forget [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (K : GName) (Tg : SnapshotM →
    IProp GF) (st : Storage) : isStorageT γ K Tg st ⊢ isStorage γ K st

theorem snapshotCert_make [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (E : CoPset) (l :
    List LogEntry) (i t : w64) (d : List w8) (m : Membership) (cs : ConfStateM) (S : List SnapRec) :
    ↑N ⊆ E → l.length = uint.nat i → Option.map LogEntry.term l.getLast? = some t → SnapListsOk {
    sid := { term' := t, index' := i }, cl := cs.lists, al := m.autoLeave, dat := d } → confStateIs
    cs m → ⊢ isCluster γ N -∗ isCommittedLogLb γ l -∗ confAt γ l.length m -∗ ownSnapsMade γ S ={E}=∗
    ownSnapsMade γ (S ++ [{ index := l.length, conf := m, data := d }]) ∗ snapshotCert γ N { sid :=
    { term' := t, index' := i }, cl := cs.lists, al := m.autoLeave, dat := d }

theorem readySnapSources_le [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (n : NodeH) (id term
    handoutTerm : w64) (ms observed : List QMsg) (bound observedBound : Nat) (q : QMsg) (SV :
    SnapshotM → IProp GF) (hq : q ∈ ms) (ht : q.st.msg.Type' = MsgSnap) (he : term = handoutTerm ∨
    term = q.st.msg.Term') (sourceInstall observedInstall : Option w64 := none) : ⊢ readySnapSources
    γ n id handoutTerm ms bound sourceInstall -∗ readySnapSources γ n id term observed observedBound
    observedInstall -∗ snapshotLeader γ id term -∗ nodeTagPin γ n SV -∗ ∃ sv, ⌜q.st.snap = some sv⌝
    ∗ (▷ SV sv ∨ ⌜uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index' ≤ observedBound⌝)

def (sealed) nodeRestoreCert (γ : Cluster) (n : NodeH) (sv : SnapshotM) : IProp GF
